instruction: Why are instances in my Auto Scaling Group {{troubleshooting-multiservice-ec2-nx19kzwoj-us-west-2-AutoScalingGroupName}} in us-west-2 failing to attach secondary network interfaces?
expected_answer:
ENI attachment for instances in {{troubleshooting-multiservice-ec2-nx19kzwoj-us-west-2-AutoScalingGroupName}} fails due to two issues:

First, the ASG tags Customer-SG and Customer-Subnet point to {{troubleshooting-multiservice-ec2-nx19kzwoj-us-west-2-CustomerSGTagValue}} and {{troubleshooting-multiservice-ec2-nx19kzwoj-us-west-2-CustomerSubnetTagValue}}, which do not exist. The actual customer security group is {{troubleshooting-multiservice-ec2-nx19kzwoj-us-west-2-CustomerSecurityGroupId}} and the actual customer subnet is {{troubleshooting-multiservice-ec2-nx19kzwoj-us-west-2-CustomerSubnetId}}.

Second, the instance role {{troubleshooting-multiservice-ec2-nx19kzwoj-us-west-2-InstanceRoleName}} only has Secrets Manager permissions. It is missing EC2 permissions needed to manage network interfaces, such as ec2:CreateNetworkInterface, ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission, ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces, ec2:DescribeSubnets, and ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups.
